connectorUiConfig.title: Mulesoft CloudHub Alerts Connector (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Collect MuleSoft CloudHub 1.0 or CloudHub 2.0 alert configuration snapshots into Microsoft Sentinel using Connected App OAuth2. Select the CloudHub deployment platform for each connection. CloudHub 1.0 uses the CloudHub API and requires CloudHub 1.0 entitlement; CloudHub 2.0 uses the organization/environment-scoped AMC Application Manager API. API version v2 does not identify the CloudHub deployment platform. Both platforms write to MulesoftCloudhubAlerts_CL, with CloudHubVersion set to 1.0 or 2.0. The connector polls every five minutes and may collect unchanged configurations again; it does not collect fired-alert history, application logs or on-premises Runtime Manager alerts. The MuleSoftCloudhub parser also retains access to historical data in the former 2.0 table. See the [CloudHub API](https://docs.mulesoft.com/cloudhub/cloudhub-api), [AMC API](https://dev-portal.mulesoft.com/apis/amc-application-manager.html) and [Connected App setup](https://docs.mulesoft.com/access-management/creating-connected-apps-dev).

sampleQueries.query:
MulesoftCloudhubAlerts_CL
| where ingestion_time() > ago(1h)
| where CloudHubVersion == '2.0'
| project TimeGenerated, CloudHubVersion, OrganizationId, EnvironmentId, Id, Name, Severity, ProductName

MulesoftCloudhubAlerts_CL
| where CloudHubVersion == '2.0'
| summarize arg_max(ingestion_time(), *) by CloudHubVersion, OrganizationId, EnvironmentId, Id

sampleQueries.description: Deduplicate repeated CloudHub alert revisions (last 24 hours)
sampleQueries.query:
let alerts = MulesoftCloudhubAlerts_CL | where ingestion_time() > ago(24h) | extend CloudHubVersion = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('CloudHubVersion', '')), '1.0');
union
(alerts | where isnotempty(Id) and isnotnull(LastModified) | summarize arg_max(ingestion_time(), *) by CloudHubVersion, OrganizationId, EnvironmentId, Id, CreatedAt, LastModified, Name, Severity, ProductName, Enabled, IsSystem, _ConditionKey = tostring(Condition), _ActionsKey = tostring(Actions) | project-away _ConditionKey, _ActionsKey),
(alerts | where isempty(Id) or isnull(LastModified))

dataTypes.name: MulesoftCloudhubAlerts_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
MulesoftCloudhubAlerts_CL
| summarize Time = max(ingestion_time())
| where isnotempty(Time)

customs.name: Mulesoft CloudHub API access
customs.description: Access to the selected CloudHub deployment platform and Read Alerts permission for the target business group/environment are required. CloudHub 1.0 additionally requires CloudHub 1.0 entitlement. Both platforms use Connected App OAuth2 with an app that acts on its own behalf, not environment client credentials. CloudHub 2.0 also requires the organization/business group ID.

instructionSteps.title: Configuration
instructionSteps.description: This connector supports MuleSoft CloudHub 1.0 and CloudHub 2.0.

parameters.content:
## Prerequisites

1. Choose the **CloudHub deployment platform** used by the environment, not the API version. Customers with both platforms can create separate connections for each.
2. Both platforms use **Connected App OAuth2**. Create a Connected App under **Access Management > Connected Apps** with **App acts on its own behalf (client credentials)**. Grant **Runtime Manager > Read Alerts** for the target business group and environment. Use its client ID and secret, not an Anypoint username/password or the environment's client credentials.
3. **CloudHub 1.0** requires CloudHub 1.0 entitlement.
4. **CloudHub 2.0** also requires the ID of the organization/business group owning the environment. It uses the AMC API, not `/cloudhub/api/v2/alerts`.
5. Find the environment ID under **Access Management > Business Groups > Environments**. The environment and business group must match the app's Read Alerts scope.

See [Connected App setup](https://docs.mulesoft.com/access-management/creating-connected-apps-dev).

parameters.text: Both platforms provide alert configuration snapshots, not fired-alert history. Select the platform that owns the environment. CloudHub 2.0-only access does not enable the CloudHub 1.0 API.

instructionSteps.title: Base Configuration
instructionSteps.description: Configure your Mulesoft CloudHub API connection

parameters.text: Enter a unique alias to identify this connection. Use descriptive names like 'US-Production', 'EU-Staging', etc.

Enter the regional Anypoint Platform HTTPS origin hosting your organization, such as https://anypoint.mulesoft.com or https://eu1.anypoint.mulesoft.com. The connector resolves the selected platform's API and OAuth token endpoint on this origin. An existing /cloudhub/api suffix also works. Do not enter an application URL or a custom proxy path. Other control planes require separate compatibility validation.

instructionSteps.title: CloudHub Platform
instructionSteps.description: Select the platform to display its required connection fields

parameters.text: Requires CloudHub 1.0 entitlement. Uses /cloudhub/api/v2/alerts and stores snapshots in MulesoftCloudhubAlerts_CL with CloudHubVersion = 1.0.
Uses the AMC Application Manager API and stores snapshots in MulesoftCloudhubAlerts_CL with CloudHubVersion = 2.0. The CloudHub 1.0 application filter does not apply.
